query:
SELECT count(*) FROM marketplace_listing
        WHERE ($1::bigint IS NULL OR listing_id = $1)
          AND ($2::bytea IS NULL OR developer = $2)
          AND ($3::text IS NULL OR status = $3)
          AND ($4::bool IS NULL OR (closed_at_slot IS NULL) = $4)
          -- ADR-39: byte-identical feed-state arms to the page query above (no table
          -- alias here) so the count can never disagree with the page.
          AND ($5::text[] IS NULL OR (
                 ('FOR_SALE' = ANY($5) AND status = 'LISTED'
                      AND listing_expiry > $6
                      AND (listed_share_amount - sold_share_amount - reserved_share_amount) > 0)
              OR ('WAITING_FOR_CLAIM' = ANY($5) AND status = 'LISTED'
                      AND (listed_share_amount - sold_share_amount - reserved_share_amount) = 0
                      AND (claim_deadline = 0 OR claim_deadline > $6))
              OR ('SOLD_OUT' = ANY($5) AND status IN ('SOLD_OUT', 'LEGAL'))
              OR ('EXPIRED' = ANY($5) AND (status = 'EXPIRED'
                      OR (status = 'LISTED'
                          AND (listed_share_amount - sold_share_amount - reserved_share_amount) > 0
                          AND listing_expiry <= $6)
                      OR (status = 'LISTED'
                          AND (listed_share_amount - sold_share_amount - reserved_share_amount) = 0
                          AND claim_deadline > 0 AND claim_deadline <= $6)))
              OR ('FINALIZED' = ANY($5) AND status = 'FINALIZED')
              OR ('CANCELLED_OR_REFUNDING' = ANY($5) AND status IN ('CANCELLED', 'REFUNDING'))))
          AND ($7::text[] IS NULL OR status = ANY($7))
          -- ADR-43: byte-identical lawyer predicates to the page query above (no table
          -- alias, no `sold_out_notifications` join — that join only feeds ORDER BY) so
          -- the count can never disagree with the page.
          AND ($8::bytea IS NULL OR (developer_lawyer = $8 OR spv_lawyer = $8))
          -- ADR-45 (refining ADR-43/44): the same live-and-SPV-open predicate as the page
          -- query above — LISTED, or SOLD_OUT with the legal window still open, an open
          -- SPV seat, and the SPV created (the EXISTS here is identical modulo the
          -- `l.`/`marketplace_listing` outer aliasing; the asset lookup is indexed by
          -- 0009's `idx_mkt_property_asset_id`).
          AND ($9::bytea IS NULL OR (
                 status IN ('LISTED', 'SOLD_OUT')
                 AND (legal_deadline = 0 OR legal_deadline > $6)
                 AND spv_lawyer = $10
                 AND developer_lawyer <> $9
                 AND spv_lawyer <> $9
                 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM marketplace_property_asset AS spa
                              WHERE spa.asset_id = marketplace_listing.asset_id
                                AND spa.spv_created)))
